The '''Christophsis blockade''' was a task force of the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Composition==
The force consisted of a number of [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Droid Control Ships]], [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]], and a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Separatist dreadnaught]].<ref name="CAM" />

==History==
The force participated in the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], maintaining the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|blockade]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] commanded the fleet. It was eventually broken at several points in the battle, with the loss of Trench's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] leading to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa's]] troops getting much-needed aid.<ref name="CAM" /> Later on, a task force commanded by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[High General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] broke the blockade to deliver more troops to hold the planet.<ref name="TCWf">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>
